system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only; the prompt contains a disagreement report per decision point (Fig. 6), but no prompt-construction mechanism is described. No code available.

env_context_strategy.note: A structured disagreement report is injected up front, and the agent also gathers evidence with tools. The 'mixed' value is the closest fit for this non-SWE domain.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no context management is described.

tool_call_format.note: The paper describes ReAct-style tool calls but not their syntax.

tool_count.note: Fig. 2 names a tool bank (Time Checker, Space Checker, Courier History, Neighborhood, ...), but the list is not exhaustive.

edit_primitive.note: Not a code-editing domain; there is no tool registry to inspect.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: ORBITERfol-lows the reasoning–action alternation of ReAct (Yao et al. 2023b), while tying each tool call to one unresolved com-parison.
loop_primitives.note: The system runs a four-stage pipeline. Inside it is a ReAct loop, and a critic can send work back to the loop for another comparison.

planning_granularity.note: The hypothesis state (hypotheses, open comparisons, evidence) is the closest thing to a plan object.

multi_agent_topology.note: One agent plus a critic reviewer; per the coding rules this counts as single.

long_term_memory.note: Historical tools retrieve comparable past decisions from the dataset. This is data access, not cross-run agent memory.

self_verification.note: The paper does not say whether the critic uses a separate model or the same one.

retry_policy.note: Critic rejection returns control to the loop at step level, subject to the evidence budget. No task-level retry is described.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Otherwise, the critic returns the missing comparison to the loop, subject to the evidence budget.
termination_condition.note: The model submits a proposal; the evidence budget is treated as a step cap.
